report_name: Heart Care Centers of Illinois Data Breach from Phishing Attack

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Attacker
threat_actors.description: An unnamed threat actor responsible for the phishing attack and data breach against Heart Care Centers of Illinois. The actor gained access to an employee email account and exfiltrated sensitive patient and employee data.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft for identity theft, financial fraud, and social engineering.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Used to steal an HCCI employee's email credentials, which provided initial access to the mailbox.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker used stolen credentials from a phishing attack to log into an employee's email account and maintain access for several months.

attack_patterns.name: Local Email Collection
attack_patterns.description: The attacker searched the compromised employee mailbox for sensitive data, including PII, PHI, and financial information contained within emails and attachments.

identities.name: Heart Care Centers of Illinois
identities.description: A cardiovascular medical practice in Illinois that suffered a data breach due to a phishing attack on an employee email account, exposing patient and employee Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

indicators.name: Creation of Email Forwarding Rule to External Address
indicators.pattern:
title: Creation of Email Forwarding Rule to External Address
id: 9c5b1f3a-8d7e-4b6f-9c1d-0a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation or modification of an email inbox rule that forwards messages to an external SMTP address. This is a common technique used by attackers after compromising an email account to exfiltrate data.
references:
  - https://www.hipaajournal.com/heart-care-centers-of-illinois-data-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-24
tags:
  - attack.t1114.003
  - attack.collection
level: high
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: audit.exchange
detection:
  selection:
    Operation:
      - 'New-InboxRule'
      - 'Set-InboxRule'
    Parameters.ForwardingSmtpAddress|exists: true
  filter_null:
    Parameters.ForwardingSmtpAddress: ''
  condition: selection and not filter_null
indicators.description: Detects the creation of new email inbox rules that forward emails to external addresses, a common TTP for data exfiltration from compromised mailboxes as suggested in the article's hunting hints.

relationships.source_name: Creation of Email Forwarding Rule to External Address
